subject.title: Feature: Project trees + threaded entry points in Control UI

question: Should this issue remain the narrow tracker for selected-message branch/copy and multi-session composer delivery, or should those remaining requirements be consolidated into the broader conversation-management tracker?
rationale: Current main implements most session-level organization, but transcript copy versus move behavior and multi-session delivery are durable product and protocol contracts that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Narrow this issue
options.body: Keep this issue for non-destructive selected-message branch/copy and explicit multi-session delivery built on existing groups and fork primitives.

options.title: Consolidate broader
options.body: Move the unique remaining requirements into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/27526 and close this issue only after that tracker preserves them.

options.title: Separate delivery
options.body: Keep selected-message branch/copy here and create a separate product-design tracker for multi-session sending.

recommendation.title: Narrow this issue
recommendation.body: Keep this issue for non-destructive selected-message branch/copy and explicit multi-session delivery built on existing groups and fork primitives.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the closest merged foundation and has already reviewed the exact product boundary in the issue discussion.
